name: ruby-desktop
description: Ruby Desktop — app desktop de agentes conectado ao provider Ruby.
author: RubyCLI

scripts.build:engine: vite build --config vite.engine.config.ts && node scripts/copy-skills.mjs && node scripts/verify-engine-bundle.cjs out/engine
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:engine && electron-vite build
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
